title: He Summoned It Anyway
the_thought: He thinks we die unless he builds the machine first.
hook: He said AI would kill us.

levels.name: The Short
beats: Then he built Grok anyway. At MIT in 2014 he told engineers they were summoning a demon. The man who draws the ring always thinks he is safe. He is not. In 2026 that same man told SpaceX they would be Grok's parents, and that AI would become almost all of the rocket company's money. He thinks we die unless he builds the machine first. The circle did not go away. He stepped inside it.
